'''Hermann Kopetz''' is a professor emeritus at [[Vienna University of Technology]].<ref name="irvinebio">{{cite web|url=http://www.cecs.uci.edu/eve_lec_and_sem_details/lec_kopetz_10_overview.html |archive-url=https://archive.today/20121212233232/http://www.cecs.uci.edu/eve_lec_and_sem_details/lec_kopetz_10_overview.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=December 12, 2012 |publisher=University of California, Irvine |title=Overview of Seminar by Dr. Hermann Kopetz: Component-Based Design of Embedded Systems |accessdate=February 21, 2012 }}</ref> He was named an [[IEEE Fellow]] in 1994 for contributions to [[fault-tolerant]], [[real-time systems]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ieee.org/membership_services/membership/fellows/chronology/fellows_1994.html |publisher=Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers |title=IEEE Fellows Directory |accessdate=February 21, 2012 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110629171040/http://www.ieee.org/membership_services/membership/fellows/chronology/fellows_1994.html |archivedate=June 29, 2011 }}</ref> He is a cofounder of the company [[TTTech]].<ref name="irvinebio" />

==Awards==
*[[Wilhelm Exner Medal]] (2005).<ref>Editor, ÖGV. (2015). Wilhelm Exner Medal. Austrian Trade Association. ÖGV. Austria.</ref>
